name: Bend Molding and Prototype
old_description: We deliver the invaluable "talk to the machinist" experience that is often absent in today's rapid tooling market. When you engage our services, it's akin to having a seasoned tooling expert by your side.
about:
Bend Molding and Prototype operates from Bend, Oregon. The company was established by mechanical engineers for mechanical engineers, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Leadership carries over 30 years of mechanical engineering experience, and the business positions itself as a domestic supplier focused on direct, machinist-level communication.

The shop specializes in fast-turn injection molding, taking plastic components from CAD designs through prototyping to full-scale production. All services—Design for Manufacturing (DFM), precision mold manufacturing, injection molding, and detailed quality reporting—are performed in-house. The engineering team also provides mechanical and product design, turning concepts into functional prototypes. Typical prototype lead time runs three to five weeks from DFM consultation to T1 samples.

The company serves mechanical engineers and product development teams needing plastic parts, though specific industry sectors are not listed. Customers gain a unified point of contact for the entire project lifecycle, from initial design through production.

Bend Molding and Prototype differentiates itself by offering the “talk to the machinist” experience, giving clients direct access to engineers and toolmakers. This collaborative approach aims to make the supplier an indispensable partner, navigating challenges with the same engineering perspective as its clients.
